plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Digi router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 332).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Digi Connect/ConnectPort router (diCpuUtilization), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Digi Connect/ConnectPort router in bytes (diTotalMemory).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Digi Connect/ConnectPort router in bytes (diFreeMemory).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Digi Connect/ConnectPort router in bytes (diUsedMemory).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Digi Connect/ConnectPort router, derived as used/total*100.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
